bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
cd "$root"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 61
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled || exit 62
old=026842b8d1a5e25d9e26a7c0ab47f75bfacf1e04
new=6b5f4b15e317f2a5667b2e1848b3d3685becce40
f=scripts/userbot_link_photo_caption_smoke.py
git fetch --no-tags origin chat/link-button-master-final-20261120 >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 63
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$new" || exit 64
test -f "$f" && test ! -L "$f" || exit 65
test "$(git hash-object "$f")" = "$(git rev-parse "$old:$f")" || exit 66
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/gace-private-photo-diagnostic.XXXXXXXX)"
cp "$f" "$tmp/old.py"
git show "$new:$f" >"$tmp/new.py"
python3 - "$tmp/new.py" <<'PY'
import pathlib,sys
compile(pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).read_bytes(),sys.argv[1],"exec")
PY
swapped=0
passed=0
cleanup(){
 rc=$?
 trap - EXIT
 if test "$swapped" = 1 && test "$passed" != 1; then
  cp "$tmp/old.py" "$root/$f" || true
  systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service || true
 fi
 rm -rf "$tmp"
 exit "$rc"
}
trap cleanup EXIT
cp "$tmp/new.py" "$f"
swapped=1
systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service || exit 67
ready=0
for i in $(seq 1 15); do
 if test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active && python3 scripts/userbot_test_client.py health >/dev/null 2>&1; then ready=1; break; fi
 sleep 2
done
test "$ready" = 1 || exit 68
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled || exit 69
passed=1
echo PHOTO_DIAGNOSTIC_SCRIPT_APPLIED=PASS
echo USERBOT_RESIDENT_AUTH=PASS
